name: Chop assist
description: A short tutorial kitchen for chop assist: one room, two boards side by side, one soup.
strategy: Get an onion onto a board, chop it with both chefs at the same board, then finish the soup. Alone, just chop and serve.

tutorial.title: Two chefs, one board
intro: A second chef at the same chopping board halves the time left on the chop. Two chefs, one board, a knife each.
It works on what is left, not the whole job: joining late still helps, just less. A third chef adds nothing.
Pots and pans never speed up. Cooking is unattended by design, and the burn timers stay honest.
With the switch off, a board is one chef's work and the second chef just waits.
Alone, the assist step is skipped; everything else still plays.

steps.text: Take an onion and put it on a chopping board.
Both chefs stand at that board and hold {interact} together. The second pair of hands halves the time left, and an x2 badge shows by the bar.
Finish the chop: hold {interact} until the onion is diced.
Chop two more, cook all three in the pot, plate the soup and serve it.

tutorial.outro: Chop assist works on any timed prep station, and on unloading a delivery. Pots and pans never speed up.
